title: The Hellbound Heart
author: Barker, Clive
review: Great short read to warm up for spooky season, only took me two hours to read. A well put together horror story with no wasted pages and really enjoyed the writing style. Will definitely check out more Barker soon!

highlights.text: The pleas became a single sound, words and sense eclipsed by panic. It seemed there was no end to this, but madness. No hope but to be lost to hope.
She wanted nothing that he could offer her, except perhaps his absence.

The flawlessly beautiful were flawlessly happy, weren’t they? To Kirsty this had always seemed self-evident. Tonight, however, the alcohol made her wonder if envy hadn’t blinded her. Perhaps to be flawless was another kind of sadness.
If nothing was worth living for it followed, didn’t it, that there was nothing worth dying for either.
But despair had taught her the fine art of squeezing blood from stones; with time she would have love from this hateful thing, or know the reason why.
But if it failed to show itself she would not grieve too deeply, for fear that the mending of broken hearts be a puzzle neither wit nor time had the skill to solve.
